description: This file declares interfaces and classes for managing process containers within the WPEFramework, including iterators for network interfaces, memory and CPU info, container instances, and a container administrator.

classes.name: INetworkInterfaceIterator
classes.description: Interface for iterating over network interfaces of a container, providing interface name and IP address information.

classes.name: IMemoryInfo
classes.description: Interface providing memory usage statistics for a container.

classes.name: IProcessorInfo
classes.description: Interface for retrieving CPU usage statistics for a container.

classes.name: IContainer
classes.description: Represents a container, providing methods to retrieve its ID, PID, status, resource usage, and control operations like start and stop.

classes.name: IContainerIterator
classes.description: Iterator for enumerating container instances, returning container IDs.

methods.name: Container
methods.description: Creates a new container instance with specified ID, search paths, log path, and configuration.

methods.name: Logging
methods.description: Enables logging for the container framework.

methods.name: Containers
methods.description: Returns an iterator over all created containers.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves a container by its ID.

ctags.name: IContainerIterator
ctags.pattern: /^    class IContainerIterator : public Core::IIterator, public Core::IReferenceCounted {$/

ctags.name: INetworkInterfaceIterator
ctags.pattern: /^    class INetworkInterfaceIterator : public Core::IIterator, public Core::IReferenceCounted {$/
